rationale: No existing spec covers the MCP Server Connection Setup card (McpServerCard hosted at /iam/mcpServer). serviceAccount.spec.js exercises the IAM Service Accounts tab, not the MCP credential flow; ai-toolsets-form-validation and iam-form-validation only share the 'MCP' keyword (AddAiToolset MCP URL) and are unrelated to the card. The feature is its own IAM sub-surface with distinct selectors (ai-integrations-mcp-*) and a unique generate-token flow, so a new GeneralTests spec is warranted. Register it in ci_matrix.json GeneralTests run_files.
